build_model: build a DQN network by name such as resnet18 or simple with action space dimensions
train: train a neural agent model on simulation data with configurable batch size and learning rate
finetune: finetune a trained model on a small new batch of task action simulation data
load_agent_from_folder: load a trained neural agent model from the latest checkpoint in an output folder
refine_actions: refine candidate actions using gradient descent on the model with cross entropy or linear loss
